description.value: Thai Cook is an authentic Thai restaurant on Victoria Crescent in downtown Nanaimo, serving dine-in, takeout, and delivery. The menu spans curries, noodles, stir-fries, and appetizers with spice levels ranging from mild to Thai hot. Many dishes are gluten-free, and multiple tofu and vegetable protein options appear throughout both the lunch and dinner menus.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms the business is active (check_date 2025-12-20, live site) with dine-in, takeout, and delivery. The website explicitly states 'DINE IN & TAKE OUT' and lists vegetarian dishes (Vegetable curries, Vegetarian Spring Rolls) and numerous GLUTEN FREE-labelled items; OSM also tags diet:vegetarian=yes. No evidence on the website or in OSM for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Thai restaurant in Nanaimo with a live website, recent OSM check date, and confirmed contact details. A useful food stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website lists a contact email (thaicook2025@gmail.com) not present in OSM tags.
